name: European long distance path E2 - part Luxemburg
description_md:
The European long distance path E2 - part Luxemburg is a waymarked hiking route spanning 177.6 km. It is signposted as E2 and is part of the international waymarked hiking network.

Walkers face 5797 m of ascent and 5979 m of descent along the way. The difficulty is hard, which is derived from distance and ascent. This route requires about 60 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. The trail passes European Museum Schengen, Schengen Agreement, and Vianden Castle within 100 m.
